title: Citizens entitled to protest; slogans like BJP 'murdabad’ and ‘Amit Shah murdabad' not ground for externment: Bombay HC
description: Protesting against decisions of the government or raising slogans against it cannot constitute a valid ground for expulsion of a citizen from any area, the Bombay High Court recently held while quashing an externment order (order banning/ expelling an individual from a locality/ district) passed against Saeed Ahmad Abdul Wahid Chaudhary, the Maharashtra State general secretary of the Socialist Democratic Party of India (SDPI) [Saeed Ahmad Abdul Wahid Chaudhary v. State of Maharashtra & Ors.]
